Ginarva is a town on the River Khursla in Ollandia. In chapter 4, its name is written “Girnava”; on the author’s map, it is “Ginarva.”

The end of the tracks (ch. 4)

The reader traveling from Catalia reaches the end of the rails here. The only way to continue is to board a low-sided steamship that takes three days to make its way down the Khursla, greeted at every landing by a brass band. At a bend in the river stands a border bastion, which fires a farewell cannon shot; the steamer answers with its whistle. Beyond lies Mergana (ch. 4).
